correctness.rationale: Direct weighted covariance calculation for weights (u,1,v)/(1+u+v), D=2(S+P)/(1+S)^2, CthetaG=(x^2-a^2)[Sx-a(v-u)]/[2(S+P)], CGG=S(a^2-x^2)^2/[2(S+P)] yields F(x)=(1-omega)x+omega a*tanh(ax/kappa^2), with 0<omega<1 for |x|<a. Strict increase/concavity of tanh gives unique stable ±x* for a^2/kappa^2>1 and origin otherwise; convex-map ordering prevents overshoot. At equality F=x-omega0*x^3/(3a^2)+O(x^5), telescoping 1/x_n^2 gives limit sqrt(n)|x_n|. The artanh inversion provides both branch asymptotics. Independent test directly evaluates covariances, without presuming reduced map, on 120 samples. Finite checks corroborate rather than prove the all-n limits.
residual_risks: Finite-precision tests can underflow at singularly small kappa; proof uses strictly positive exact exponential weights.
